summary: Custom vars plugins go in a vars_plugins directory next to the play, inside a role or in a configured path, but plays and roles load too late for inventory-time plugins. Most are disabled by default except host_group_vars. Enable them with vars_plugins_enabled or ANSIBLE_VARS_ENABLED. Collection vars plugins (2.10+) must be enabled explicitly by FQCN.
questions: How do I enable a vars plugin from a collection?
Why doesn't my vars plugin in a role run during inventory loading?
Which vars plugins are enabled by default?
Which environment variable lists the enabled vars plugins?
Do I need to keep host_group_vars in vars_plugins_enabled?

answer_card.title: Enabling vars plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
Put custom vars plugins in `vars_plugins/` next to your play, in a role, or in a configured directory. Plugins that must run while inventory builds can't live in a play or role, because those load later.

Only `host_group_vars` is on by default. Enable others in `ansible.cfg` (or with `ANSIBLE_VARS_ENABLED`). Collection plugins need the FQCN:

```ini
[defaults]
vars_plugins_enabled = host_group_vars,namespace.collection_name.vars_plugin_name
```

Keep `host_group_vars` in the list, or `host_vars`/`group_vars` stop loading.
